title: Roosters Playful Animations
description: An animation and effect-focused modpack made with performance in mind, and a slightly stylized aesthetic so that everyone will be able to enjoy the base pack, or customize it to their own tastes. Vanilla Plus!
body:
### Permissions

**You may use and modify this modpack for personal use only. Redistribution of this modpack, including modified versions, is not permitted on any platform. Commercial use of this modpack or its contents requires explicit permission from the creator.**

_____________________________________________________________________________________________

An animation, visual effects, and quality-of-life focused modpack designed to stay true to Minecraft's vanilla style while enhancing the overall experience. Built with performance in mind, it aims to run smoothly on a wide range of devices while offering a polished, slightly stylized Vanilla+ aesthetic.

While being completely playable out of the box, the modpack can also easily be customized to suit personal preferences.

If you enjoy Vanilla+ modpacks with improved visuals and smoother gameplay, this pack may be for you.


**Recommended RAM Allocation:** 8 GB or more

_____________________________________________________________________________________________

   **Features**

* Enhanced animations and visual effects
* Improved performance and optimization
* Better terrain generation and world variety
* Additional structures and exploration content (E.G, bridges) 
* Upgraded mob, projectile, and GUI visuals
* Expanded building options and convenience features
* Quality-of-life improvements throughout the game
* Enhanced sound design and ambience

 **And much more**
